commands.label: Show face
commands.description: Draw ASCII art on the screen: plain keyboard characters, in the biggest text size that fits, centred. colour is RGB565.

commands.label: Play melody
commands.description: Play a ringtone-style (RTTTL) melody through the speaker.

commands.label: Volume
commands.description: Speaker volume from 0 (silent) to 1 (loudest). 0.3 to 0.5 is comfortable; 1 distorts. The robot's screen shows the volume bar when it changes.

commands.label: Lights
commands.description: Hold the 3x3 light grid at one colour. Each of r, g and b is 0 to 255. The grid stops being the sound meter until led_meter, or the robot's button.

commands.label: Play light animation
commands.description: Play a three-second animation on the light grid in this colour, then go back to what the grid was showing.

commands.label: Lights back to sound meter
commands.description: Give the light grid back to the sound level meter.

How loud the microphone hears the room, 0 to 32767, every 250 ms.
1 while the microphone is muted (knob pushed), 0 while it is on. Sent on change and every 2 s. The page shows a red notice.
